title: Review submission package
docSubtitle: Pre-submission checks, decision basis, and generation history in one document.
noFinal: No asset has been marked final yet. Finalize an asset first.
manualHint: Confirm these items against the current basis.
warnIncomplete: Not ready to submit — {n} item(s) outstanding
autoHint: These items are determined from the record and cannot be toggled.
hint.finalized: Recorded once you mark an asset as final.
hint.verified: Recorded once guide verification passes every rule.
hint.history: Recorded automatically when you generate an asset.
hint.guideVersion: Recorded when you generate from a project that has a brand guide uploaded.
manual.thirdPartyAssets: No material with unclear rights was used
footnote: This package is compiled from the generation history and verification results recorded in CLAPS Studio. Manually checked items reflect the submitter's own confirmation.
metadataOnly: Archived record: issued snapshots are read only.
stale: The basis changed. Confirm all three items again.
printNotice: Browser print document; no transmission, approval or server signed PDF.
retryHint: The response could not be confirmed. Retry checks the original request. Choose a new issuance to create a separate document.
issuedLimit: Showing the 20 most recent documents. Open an older document by its issuance ID or a ?snapshot=issuanceID URL.
